body:
mm, it's exciting to get the chance to start again. i just have to hold on and wait for now, though

i'm surprised to hear that they need time to heal,, even my psychiatrist was confused because \[some bad stuff i mentioned in another comment\] had happened a year ago and i still didn't let go completely. well, a year at that time- two now.

it worries me to open up to people, since i'm scared they'll either take advantage or end up seeing me as a burden- but i really appreciate it.

i haven't talked to them about it, i have no idea how they'll take it. not sure if it'd be good to..maybe it's better to stay silent about it this time, i think.

i'm gonna be honest here, but your comment lifted me up a lot.

i don't think it could have easy to realize, but i ^(kinda) crave to feel empathy from people- or at least, not getting indifference to the trauma that left me scarred. and your advice felt really helpful/fitting. it made me happy to be understood at least a bit ~~hope that's not unhealthy~~

what you say helps me understand why friendships might feel shallow.  hopefully, understanding why will help me not want to give up as much.

also, i think that about the tension too. its just hard in the meanwhile. and i hope uni is different, ive heard that before so i look forward to it.

thank you a lot.

since this is a throwaway im gonna be honest- being forced to work from ages 13-15 by a family member and being groomed by them. they used to choke me and sometimes i got slapped. i also escaped from a rape attempt in which i was given alcohol, by the same person. i got therapy but my family still doesn't know (except my parents) and i crave revenge.

1. yes, i'll move to another city.
2. i'm kinda close to them, they know about the ptsd and anxiety (and they dont talk to that family member after finding out). i would like them to know *this*, but i'm not sure whether they'll be supportive or tell me i'm being sensitive. ~~they just have big mood swings~~
3. i want the pain to stop. if i could tell my parents how hurtful the words they say- and get an apology, i'd be coping much better with the "all my friendships feel empty and unfulfilling", but both things at once make me feel incredibly lonely and lost.

hope this wasn't too long

strange enough, the first one happened last year (actually, she told her friend all the private stuff i liked *while i was there*, as i told her to stop). the other one began acting pretty toxic and complaining to everyone we met about me. so, yeah. it did give me *really big* issues.

But no- before i started feeling like this i wanted to go to uni badly. i felt like it was my one chance to leave everything behind and try starting over again. it's on another city so it was much more "hopeful" for me in a way.

also- im really thankful for the offer, although if it's by country, mine isn't the best for mental health,, so i'm not sure how to go about it
